name: Call for emergency help
short_description: Contact the locally appropriate emergency service and give location, hazard, and casualty information.
self_assessment: I can call emergency help and state three essential details without another person's help.
description: Contact the locally appropriate emergency service and give location, hazard, and casualty information. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Report a location, hazard, and number of people affected
safety_note: Delay or incorrect location details can endanger people; move only if needed for safety, call promptly, and follow the dispatcher's instructions.
